title: DataRecord
description: Unified record format for all biomedical data flowing through the pipeline. Every stage outputs lists of these. Defined in ARCHITECTURE.md section 3.1.5.

record_id.description: Globally unique record identifier. Format: <source>-<hash8> e.g. 'pubmed-a1b2c3d4'.

task_id.description: The task that produced this record.

fields.description: Field name → value. Field names MUST be unified names (see field_mapping.schema.yaml). Values can be string, number, boolean, array, or nested object.

field_descriptions.description: Optional. Field name → human-readable description. Useful when fields are domain-specific.

extraction_method.description: How the data was extracted from the source.

extraction_confidence.description: Confidence in the extraction. 1.0 = direct API call, 0.5 = noisy OCR, etc.

processing_log.description: List of processing steps applied to this record. Each step is a ProvenanceNode reference.

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was created.
